description: Global, document-wide styling and head settings (maps to the MJML <mj-head> globals and the mj-body attributes).

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: Gets or sets the body background colour (mj-body background-color).

members.name: Breakpoint
members.description: Gets or sets the mobile breakpoint width (mj-breakpoint width).
